vulnerability.name: CVE-2026-84304
vulnerability.description: gRPC-go: heap memory exhaustion via HTTP/2 DATA frame fragmentation

statements.impact_statement: The vulnerable grpc-go is vendored inside the upstream Trivy release binary the image carries (/usr/local/bin/trivy), not in my-project code. It only ever runs as a client; nothing in the image terminates an HTTP/2 connection of its own.
statements.action_statement: Bump TRIVY_VERSION to the first Trivy release whose go.mod carries grpc-go >= 1.83.1, and delete this statement together with its .trivyignore.yaml entry.
